title: AGI ALPHA: THE ADVANTAGE YOU CAN BUILD
subtitle: Constructive Foresight for the Intelligence Transition
stage: initial design; before any numerical experiment
mission: Qualify repeated sparse-system investigations before an explicit local computational deadline, with reusable setup and independently inspectable evidence.
beneficiary: Numerical researchers using public benchmarks; no recruited external beneficiary or commercial acceptance is claimed.
bottleneck: Repeated setup and the lead time needed to build, validate and restore a solver capability before a short response deadline.
data_license: CC-BY-4.0; original Matrix Market metadata and bytes retained
selection: Four fixed compact real-origin structural/power matrices selected by public domain and size metadata, before numerical outcomes; no replacements or dropped failures.

alternatives_rejected.energy_design: A real operational claim would require engineering context, permissions and external safety acceptance not available.
alternatives_rejected.research_instrumentation: Physical detector access and calibration unavailable; avoids duplicating earlier spectral-instrument work.
alternatives_rejected.biomedical_discovery: Experimental validation and beneficiary acceptance cannot be established in this bounded session.
alternatives_rejected.software_release_verification: Useful but would overlap existing held integration lanes; the numerical instrument can use only permitted published boundaries.

hypotheses.H1: At q=16, a qualified reusable instrument reduces full measured batch runtime compared with repeated cold direct solves; stronger cached-LU comparison determines incremental numerical advantage.
hypotheses.H2: Constructive foresight has positive paired net modeled mission value against the strongest credible comparator selected using calibration only; failure/tie is a valid verdict.
hypotheses.H3: Frozen per-target empirical delivery probabilities improve Brier score over the calibration-only constant base rate on later local computational runs.
hypotheses.H4: The unchanged published authority boundary rejects missing or stale authority and stale capability evidence, while restored lineage alone conveys neither authority nor fresh proof.

numerical_design.solver: scipy.sparse.linalg.splu; float64; COLAMD; otherwise SciPy defaults
numerical_design.cold_direct: New factorization per right-hand side; ablation only, not strongest comparator.
numerical_design.native_cached: One conventional SuperLU factorization per batch, reused for all right-hand sides; identical per-output acceptance checks.
numerical_design.certified_ready: Same solver plus exact matrix/source recipe binding and two fixed manufactured preflight solves. Reuse existing factors. Restoration refactorizes and revalidates; never claims to restore a serialized ready factor.
numerical_design.seed_formula: base + 100*matrix_index + block; deterministic NumPy PCG64 normals; generate a q=16 array then take q-prefixes
numerical_design.development_limit: One engineering block per matrix, all q/method cells; at most two bug-fix reruns retained separately. No confirmation seeds may be opened during development.
numerical_design.manufactured_rhs: x_star sampled from standard normal; b=A*x_star; these are synthetic right-hand sides on real-origin matrices.
numerical_design.diagnostic_cg: Jacobi-preconditioned CG, rtol=1e-10, atol=0, maxiter=400; one RHS for each fixed matrix and block0 in development, calibration and confirmation; diagnostic only.
numerical_design.timing: Single BLAS thread; perf_counter and process_time; random method order within matrix/block/q; record input read/hash, RHS generation, factorization, preflight, solve, verification, metadata and total separately. All method outputs receive the same numerical checker.
numerical_design.deadline_reference: Per-matrix/q median calibration native_cached total seconds; primary multiplier1.0. Freeze exact numbers before confirmation.
numerical_design.forecast_targets: Qualified local batch delivery before frozen elapsed deadline, conditional on method and state (cold including setup; ready excluding prior paid setup). Every issue timestamp must precede corresponding execution.
numerical_design.forecast: Calibration empirical counts with Beta(1,1) smoothing, (successes+1)/(n+2); no fitting on confirmation.
numerical_design.base_rate: Calibration-only constant probability pooled over the same forecast target definitions; methods may use all contemporaneous calibration observations.
numerical_design.stopping: Stop and record unexecuted planned cells if budget reached; no outcome-dependent sample-size extension or matrix replacement. Infrastructure errors and reruns remain in amendments.

decision_design.status: Exact finite model and source to be frozen separately before any calibration or confirmation decision trials; this initial commitment fixes question, arms, regimes, seeds and boundaries.
decision_design.oracle: Perfect-future reference is an upper bound only, excluded from eligible comparative claims.
decision_design.pairing: Identical exogenous worlds for every policy; sample-seed blocks are Monte Carlo clusters, not beneficiaries.
decision_design.units: Observed computational costs scaled by one common measured setup-time denominator; no implied day-scale engineering lead time. Adoption, competition, price compression, demand and expiry remain assumptions.
decision_design.imitation: Changes credible alternative availability; does not erase beneficiary CPU savings.
decision_design.primary_comparator: Best eligible policy selected on calibration only; also report pairwise results against every strong comparator.
decision_design.uncertainty: Paired seed-block bootstrap95% intervals with2000resamples; matrix-specific numerical results and block-level timing intervals; no population-of-industries inference.

costs: Measured process/wall seconds, bytes, calls, preflight/validation/failed attempts, policy work and restoration; unknown authoring inference charge/human review/maintenance are null, not zero. Cash spend and settled revenue separately reported. Monetary sensitivity uses explicit user-editable rates and amortization only.
causal_scope: Randomized order supports local implementation comparisons; controlled model interventions support causal statements only inside the simulation. No customer adoption, sector forecast or economic causal effect established.
prospective_scope: Later local computational delivery outcomes can resolve; external adoption at7and30days stays pending absent observed acceptance.
contamination: Historical public matrices may be familiar to language models. No claim of clean historical model forecasting; novel local runtime outcomes are measured after predictions freeze.
scope_limits: No live financial actions, new operational credentials, paid infrastructure, security changes, shared-catalog edits before receiving acknowledgment, or held runtime execution.
amendments: Immutable initial protocol; append dated amendments with reason and outcomes visible at the time. Freeze actual executable source and calibration-derived forecast file before confirmation.
